verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 964 exact head

lessons: History should reuse canonical replay rather than create a permissive second state machine.
Complete validation before return prevents partial trusted evidence.
Exact-stream inspection grants no mutation, undo, discovery, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
